name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based 1-2 frame press and wave release input buffer.

stage.name: Start Stage
stage.description: Active stage. F6 in a level cycles Stage 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → Off.

stage1-all-ms.name: Stage 1: max delay (ms)
stage1-all-ms.description: Longest delay the buffer may add to a click in cube/ball/ufo/etc. Rounded to the nearest physics tick (~4.2 ms at 240 TPS).

stage1-wave-ms.name: Stage 1: max delay, Wave (ms)
stage1-wave-ms.description: Same, but for Wave / Mini Wave.

stage2-all-ms.name: Stage 2: max delay (ms)
stage2-all-ms.description: Longest delay the buffer may add to a click in cube/ball/ufo/etc. Rounded to the nearest physics tick (~4.2 ms at 240 TPS).

stage2-wave-ms.name: Stage 2: max delay, Wave (ms)
stage2-wave-ms.description: Same, but for Wave / Mini Wave.

stage3-all-ms.name: Stage 3: max delay (ms)
stage3-all-ms.description: Longest delay the buffer may add to a click in cube/ball/ufo/etc. Rounded to the nearest physics tick (~4.2 ms at 240 TPS).

stage3-wave-ms.name: Stage 3: max delay, Wave (ms)
stage3-wave-ms.description: Same, but for Wave / Mini Wave.

stage4-all-ms.name: Stage 4: max delay (ms)
stage4-all-ms.description: Longest delay the buffer may add to a click in cube/ball/ufo/etc. Rounded to the nearest physics tick (~4.2 ms at 240 TPS).

stage4-wave-ms.name: Stage 4: max delay, Wave (ms)
stage4-wave-ms.description: Same, but for Wave / Mini Wave.

assume-release-after-takeoff.name: Assume tap jumps
assume-release-after-takeoff.description: Predict cube/ball jumps as a tap (button released after takeoff) instead of held forever. Turn off if the buffer delays clicks you would hold.

show-notifications.name: On-screen notifications
show-notifications.description: Shows "Saved +X ms" when the buffer rescues a click, and the stage on F6.

debug-log.name: Debug log
debug-log.description: Write buffer events to the Geode log.
